meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Expert data processing specialist with intelligent DuckDB/Polars selection for maximum performance. Always includes numpy, never uses pandas, runs everything through uv. Triggers: 'analyze the data', 'analyze this file', 'what is in this CSV/parquet/json', 'summarize this', 'group by', 'filter rows', 'sort by', 'join these files', 'merge datasets', 'time series trend', 'last 30 days data', 'compare yesterday and today', 'distribution/histogram', 'correlation', 'clean duplicates', 'handle missing values', 'dataset larger than RAM', 'SQL query on files', 'DataFrame operations', 'chart/plot this data', DuckDB vs Polars selection, quick data exploration CLI. NOT for plain text/code inspection, configs, or tiny inline math.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 CSV、Parquet 等数据文件,完成汇总、筛选与关联统计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对数据文件想快速搞清规律和统计结果
copy.tagline_en: Analyze CSV, Parquet, and JSON files to summarize, filter, and join data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with data files and want quick insights without complex coding

howto.what: 它会变成数据处理专家:分析 CSV、Parquet 等文件时,自动在 DuckDB 与 Polars 间选工具,通过 uv 运行并始终带上 numpy,绝不使用 pandas。能完成过滤、排序、分组等常见数据操作,也能处理超过内存的数据。
howto.when: 当你说出“analyze the data”“summarize this”等触发词,或要求分析 CSV、Parquet、JSON 等数据文件时触发。纯文本阅读、配置查看、简单心算不触发。

say.text: 分析这个 CSV 文件,按类别汇总总金额
say.note: 会触发 DuckDB 直接查询并按类别分组聚合。

say.text: 把这个 parquet 文件里 amount 大于 100 的行过滤出来
say.note: 会用 Polars 惰性扫描并过滤。

say.text: 对比昨天和今天的数据趋势,并画图
say.note: 会加入 matplotlib 生成趋势图。

howto.what_en: Turns Claude into a data processing specialist: analyzes CSV/Parquet files, auto-selects DuckDB or Polars, runs via uv with numpy, never pandas. Supports common data operations (filter, sort, group) and out-of-core datasets.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say keywords like 'analyze the data', 'summarize this', or ask to analyze CSV/Parquet/JSON data files. Not for plain text/code inspection, configs, or tiny inline math.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV file and total amounts by category.
say_en.note: Triggers a DuckDB direct query with GROUP BY.

say_en.text: Filter rows where amount > 100 in this parquet file.
say_en.note: Uses Polars lazy scan and filter.

say_en.text: Compare yesterday's and today's trends and plot them.
say_en.note: Adds matplotlib and produces a trend chart.
